principle: No product is represented as insured unless an authorized insurer, custodian, or statutory insurance program has verified applicable coverage.

policies.scope: per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category; subject to FDIC requirements
only when held at an appropriately insured institution and all requirements are met
only for eligible securities/cash at a SIPC-member broker-dealer; not general bank deposits or tokens
must be supplied by the actual issuer/program; not inferred from Visa/Mastercard branding
merchant/payment operational coverage must be contractually evidenced
token reserve, custody, and loss protection must be separately documented; no statutory deposit-insurance claim
ledger errors/fraud require contractual controls and applicable insurance

automaticActions: block activation when required evidence is missing or stale
route incidents and claims to authorized carriers/custodians
reconcile insured balances against provider records
